name: Spiral
insight: Built by Dan Shipper's AI media company Every; Spiral 4.0 went agent-native with MCP, CLI, and API access.
tagline: An AI writing partner that learns your voice and keeps it consistent everywhere.
description: An AI writing partner from Every that uses stylometry — analysis of your linguistic patterns — to build a profile of your voice and write in it. It interviews you before drafting, produces three parallel versions to mix and match, and carries your style from tweets to long-form essays.
edge: Goes deeper on voice-matching than generic AI writers — a stylometry-built profile of your prose keeps drafts in your register, not the model's.
pros: Agent access via MCP, CLI, API

references.title: Spiral: The AI writing partner with taste
